summary: Detailed description of different pulse images and their significance

sections.title: Pulse Images Chapter One
sections.originalText: 浮脉为表，沉脉为里，迟脉为寒，数脉为热。
sections.translation: Floating pulse indicates exterior, deep pulse indicates interior, slow pulse indicates cold, rapid pulse indicates heat.
sections.interpretation: This chapter provides the basic classification of pulse images according to location and speed.

keyConcepts.description: Different characteristics and qualities of pulse in diagnosis
